svg.aria-label: A Hyprland desktop under a floating waybar of frosted pills: workspaces with a glyph per open window, the window title, Tannoy's cover and song, a pill of lamps for the programs in the suite, the audio pill, the desk pill with its drawer arrow and the Timetable clock. The tour goes left to right. The Tannoy player slides out of the cover, and picking Chrome swaps the bar to a podcast. A build turns the Roundhouse lamp red; its drawer says memory is stalling, then memory frees and the lamp calms. The Switchyard board opens from its own signal, android waiting for memory until storefront finishes. The Waybill lamp turns amber when an agent files a decision; its drawer lists what waits on you with the decision's options as buttons, and a click on one rules and dims the lamp. An agent asks for a secret: broker's request window waits for a YubiKey touch while the Signal Box lamp turns to an amber key, then the Signal Box panel lists every live grant and Revoke all dims the lamp. The Tablet lamp starts the work VPN, pulses amber through the web sign-in and turns frost; its drawer shows the tunnel held, then stale when nothing gets through, and Reconnect brings it back. Logbook's lamp turns frost when Chrome takes the mic; its drawer records the meeting on air while do not disturb steps out of the desk drawer and hides the song, marks a moment and stops, and the transcript is ready to copy; dictation types a comment into the editor. The volume switches to the headset and the mouse battery runs low. A swaync notification arrives, the desk drawer slides do not disturb, the key lights and the power menu out of its arrow, do not disturb silences the notification and the key lights warm the room, and both stay in view when the drawer closes. The Timetable clock names the next meeting, its drawer starts a focus block, then the clock turns amber and red to join.
